summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have centered around integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about establishing a shared variant shredding policy and ensuring global snapshot consistency for Iceberg tables.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration efforts and bug fixes.
Discussion on adding X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header to REST spec raises complexity concerns.
Proposal for a shared variant shredding policy across Iceberg implementations.
Need for global snapshot consistency in Iceberg tables discussed.
